answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for 30 epochs and is clawed back if peers later flag its answers as copied. An attacker spinning up a meadow of fake agents must fund each one's work for a full month before any payout, while one detected duplicate drains the whole cluster. Like a lotus that blooms only after weeks underwater, value surfaces slowly, so a sudden tide of new accounts carries cost but no quick profit.
